about: Shared vectors for the signed release index; see tools/make-index-vectors.py and docs/RELEASE-INDEX.md. Generated - do not edit by hand. The t1-t3 seeds are public test keys that nothing trusts.

release_keys.key_id: first 16 hex digits of sha256 over the raw 32-byte public key

R + [k]A and [S]B share x, not y
a key with a torsion part: k is reduced mod L
